  • button-md-height — The md height never drops below the md size token, which is 32px.
  • button-lg-height — The lg height never drops below the lg size token, which is 36px.
  • button-md-gap — The gap between the icon and the label is two spacing steps.
  • button-icon-md-height — An icon-only button drops the line-height floor and uses the token alone.
  • button-icon-md-aspect — The square aspect makes the 32px height its width as well.
